children: Redwood Trust declared Q3 2026 common and Series A preferred dividends and announced a proposed $150 million convertible notes offering.
Board declared Q3 2026 common dividend of $0.18 per share, payable Sept 30, 2026 to holders of record Sept 23, 2026.
Board declared Q3 2026 Series A preferred dividend of $0.625 per share, payable Oct 15, 2026 to holders of record Oct 1, 2026.
Reached preliminary agreements to sell legacy bridge loans with up to ~$190M unpaid principal; expected close late Q3/early Q4 2026.
Estimated preliminary impact of the proposed dispositions: ~2% decrease in book value per share from June 30, 2026.
Proposed private offering of $150M convertible senior notes due 2030 (plus $22.5M option); proceeds to fund repurchases and corporate uses.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Redwood Trust declares Q3 dividends, proposes $150M convertible notes offering
